innovation_summary: Omega-side load-shed controller in the Colossus energy pair: given an oversubscribed power budget from the Alpha budget model, it selects and sheds prioritized workloads until the megawatt deficit is met. Unlike most historical variants in this family, its behavior was actually executed - the energy family truth gate pinned this repository at an exact commit and ran a cross-repository scenario in which a 3.6 MW deficit was met by shedding a 20.0 MW batch-training job (priority 9), producing a hashed CI artifact. It remains classified historical and its parent receipt flags synthetic confidence fields in the child repositories that still need quarantine.
